entities.summary:
Freedom House is an American non-profit research and advocacy organisation founded in 1941 in Washington, D.C., to promote democracy and report on political rights and civil liberties worldwide. Its annual Freedom in the World surveys became widely cited indices in journalism, academia, and diplomacy.

Born amid antifascist and later Cold War liberal internationalism, Freedom House evolved into a democracy-rating institution whose methodology and funding (including U.S. government grants) draw both reliance and critique from governments scored as ‘Not Free’.

Freedom House shows how NGOs can become quasi-standard-setters in global democracy discourse.
